properties.NAME: Colorado Terr.
properties.CHANGE: The United States created Colorado Territory from Nebraska, New Mexico, and Utah Territories, and from the former Kansas Territory. Boundaries were identical to the state of Colorado.
properties.CITATION: (U.S. Stat., vol. 12, ch. 59[1861]/pp. 172-177; Van Zandt, 141; Noel, Mahoney, and Stevens, Historical Atlas of Colorado, ch. 2, sec. 12)
